name: services/cards/mcard_order2

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of selected fields and their values.

Available fields:

  • id - ID of the order;

  • order_date - Datetime string with time of order;

  • status - status of the order.

    Possible values:

    • pending - the order is waiting to be sent to the external service

    • in_progress - the order is being processed by the external service

    • ready_to_receive - the order is completed and the card is waiting to be installed on the user's device

    • received - the card is installed on the user's device

    • error - an error occurred

    • revoked_by_me - the card has been revoked by the user

    • revoked - the card has been revoked by the system

  • token - If order has status 'ready' token for mObywatel app will be returned;

  • distribution_pass - If order has status 'ready' distribution password will be returned;

  • student_number - Student number related to mcard;

  • expiration_date - Expiration date of mcard.
